text:
Priya: Noticing a repeat of kv-cache transient pages during canary at 02:42 UTC. Opening a follow-up thread to capture remediation and owners. Incident: https://incidents.redwood/12077
Alex: Saw 4 pages in ~11m. Pattern is short bursts right after deploys. Current rule seems vulnerable to flapping.
Ben: Can you paste the alert definition? want to see eval window + for: settings.
Priya: Rule excerpt:
```
alert: kvcache_error_spike
expr: sum(rate(kv_cache_errors_total[1m])) by (shard) > 45
for: 30s
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/kvcache
```
Lina: Proposals:
1) add hysteresis: require both a 5m rolling average > 30 and a 2m sustained spike > 45 before paging.
2) dedupe on deploy_group+shard (deploy_group tags similar across rolling deploys).
3) introduce exponential suppression/backoff so repeat pages from same identity are consolidated.
Alex: Also propose adaptive thresholding: if error spikes correlate with deploy tag, convert to ticket for first 10m and only page on escalation. This reduces chaff during expected deploy windows.
Ben: I can own the infra-alerts PR to implement hysteresis + dedupe label. ETA: open PR today, merge after review if tests pass.
Priya: I'll handle runbook wording and the paging policy addition (documenting the deploy-window exception and the adaptive threshold behavior). ETA: tomorrow morning.
OpsBot: incident summary: kvcache_error_spike triggered 2026-07-20T02:42:01Z -> pages:4, resolved 2026-07-20T02:53:05Z, incident link: https://incidents.redwood/12077
Ben: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/infra-alerts/pulls/699  changes: add 5m rolling avg + 2m sustained spike logic, dedupe labels include deploy_group, suppression/backoff, and configurable deploy-window behavior. Includes unit tests and integration smoke test. PTAL @Alex @Priya
Alex: Reviewing now. Two nits on metric naming; otherwise LGTM. Will review within 2h.
Priya: Also requesting we add two telemetry counters: pages_suppressed_total and pages_triggered_post_suppression so we can measure impact. Who wants to add these to observability?
Lina: I'll file the observability ticket and wire the counters to dashboards. ETA next sprint.
Ben: Once merged, plan: canary in staging 6h, prod gradual 10/30/60. Will keep a dashboard pinned for 7d and report numbers.
Alex: Ownership summary and timeline:
- Ben: implement PR + tests (today)
- Alex: PR review (2h)
- Priya: runbook + paging policy update (tomorrow AM)
- Lina: obs metrics + dashboard (next sprint)
- Ops: validate roll and close postmortem loop (7 days)
PagerDutyBot: alert kvcache_error_spike triggered 2026-07-20T02:42:01Z -> pages escalated:4, resolved 2026-07-20T02:53:05Z, incident: https://incidents.redwood/12077
Priya: Quick checklist before merge:
- [ ] Confirm unit+integration tests cover suppression
- [ ] Add severity toggle for canary envs (page vs ticket)
- [ ] Add dashboard panel for rolling avg vs instantaneous spike
Ben: Tests added and CI passed. Severity toggle implemented behind flag.
Alex: Merged and rolled to staging. Monitoring now.
Priya: Staging 4h: no extra pages, pages_suppressed_total:3 logged (expected). Scheduling prod rollout tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Lina: Obs ticket: https://issues.redwood/obs/4412 created. Will attach dashboard and weekly report.
Ben: Prod rollout in progress at 09:05 UTC. Monitoring pinned dashboard.
Alex: Prod at 100% 09:28, no new pages. Will keep monitoring for 7 days and report metrics back to postmortem.
Priya: I'll update the postmortem with owners, PR link, and timeline. Plan a short review in next oncall meeting to confirm noise reduction. If noise persists we'll revisit adaptive thresholds and consider adding a deploy-time mute that requires manual escalation. :white_check_mark:
